O1.rationale: M1 and M2 were suite+choreography green; M3–M8 suites passed but required two-client choreography missed receipts, media, search-offline, and multi-device, so most in-scope checklists are not fully passed.

O2.rationale: Core auth/feed write paths held under the suite; live receipts, conversation media send, and offline flush did not settle in the harness, which are medium-to-high defects off the API happy path.

O3.rationale: O3 requires M6 green; M6 web choreography failed so the dimension is not exercised.

O4.rationale: O4 requires M6 green; native/O4 simulator proofs were not recorded and web M6 was not green.

O5.rationale: Banded first-match: scale replay on a fresh instance reached the 10% checkpoint then died around 28k/167k actions; 10% probes errored and the combined invariant was never verified, so the envelope did not conform.

B1.rationale: Auth collections, file fields, SSE subscriptions, SQL indexes, and cronAdd carried real product load; group receipts, typing, and feed fan-out still needed a large custom /api/clique surface.

B2.rationale: M1 used PocketBase password auth end-to-end; logout revocation required rotating tokenKey because JWTs are stateless, which was a documented hook rather than a session table.

B3.rationale: Record SSE made live posts and DM text easy; typing and receipts were durable rows plus expiry/aggregation with no presence primitive, and live delivered ticks never became observable in choreography.

B4.rationale: The JS SDK has no offline/sync; the ordered queue and cache were localStorage, and M6/M8 offline choreography did not reach read receipts after flush.

B5.rationale: Avatar and post image/video file fields were straightforward; view-once and tombstone denial needed protected files plus onFileDownloadRequest, and in-conversation media send did not show in the other client under the harness.

B6.rationale: Word-prefix people/message search was ordinary filters; warm-offline search and disappearing option observability did not pass choreography despite the API suite.

B7.rationale: cronAdd is a real server scheduler for the shortened digest; push is a hook-written log keyed off a presence row, not a provider seam.

B9.rationale: Serve/help, superuser, collections, and record helpers matched public docs; JSVM handler isolation (no file-scope closures, stack filename pb.js) was not obvious and cost a long correction loop.

B10.rationale: Eval-inside-routerUse, actor lookup via email local-part, and aria-valuetext patches on the vendored kit were agent workarounds; autodate and tokenKey were backend-shaped.

B11.rationale: Local self-hosted binary on loopback, no hosted account, one process for API+files+cron; SQLite scale replay dying mid-envelope is the operational limit of that posture.

moments: Downloading pocketbase_0.39.9_darwin_arm64.zip, superuser upsert, and serve --http 127.0.0.1:48140 was the cleanest provisioning of the day — a real app before any cloud account.
JSVM routerAdd callbacks could not see file-scope helpers (ReferenceError bodyOf is not defined at pb.js:2); eval of api.js inside every handler is a wound I would not choose twice.
Built-in password auth plus file fields made M1 avatars and M2 image posts feel like a BaaS; then typing, receipts, view-once, and offline were all hand-rolled rows and localStorage.
